steps.dump: (() => { const chip = document.querySelector('[data-testid=endless-depth-chip]'); const all = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div')); const gear = all.find(d => /^\d\/7 gear$/.test((d.textContent || '').trim()) && d.children.length === 0) || all.find(d => /^\d\/7 gear$/.test((d.textContent || '').trim())); const out = {}; if (chip) { const r = chip.getBoundingClientRect(); out.chip = { text: chip.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(), top: Math.round(r.top), bottom: Math.round(r.bottom), left: Math.round(r.left), right: Math.round(r.right) }; } if (gear) { const r = gear.getBoundingClientRect(); out.gear = { text: gear.textContent.trim(), top: Math.round(r.top), bottom: Math.round(r.bottom), left: Math.round(r.left), right: Math.round(r.right) }; } if (out.chip && out.gear) { out.vOverlap = Math.max(0, Math.min(out.chip.bottom, out.gear.bottom) - Math.max(out.chip.top, out.gear.top)); out.hOverlap = Math.max(0, Math.min(out.chip.right, out.gear.right) - Math.max(out.chip.left, out.gear.left)); } return JSON.stringify(out); })()
